company_name: NIPPON STEEL STAINLESS STEEL PIPE CO., LTD.
semiconductor_relevance: High — Nippon Steel Stainless Steel Pipe Co., Ltd. specializes in ultra-high purity pipes essential for the distribution of high purity gases and liquids in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Nippon Steel Stainless Steel Pipe Co., Ltd. manufactures ultra-high purity super clean pipes designed for the semiconductor industry, ensuring minimal contamination of gases and liquids. Their products are critical for maintaining the integrity of processes in semiconductor fabrication plants.
